case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 1384-1385 OF 2009 AND CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 700 OF 2011
summary: Prior enmity from water dispute; FIR recorded via Dehati Nalishi by deceased Hukum Singh who died days later; multiple contradictory witness testimonies regarding occurrence details and police recording; prosecution witnesses (P.W.1, P.W.4, P.W.12, P.W.13, P.W.18) identified accused only in court without TIP; inconsistencies in timing (5 p.m. police arrival vs prosecution claim); evidence reliance issues due to thumb impression on FIR appearing as afterthought; trial court conviction under IPC s.302/149, 324/149 modified by HC to s.304 Part II for one deceased; appeal challenged life imprisonment
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.148, s.302/149, s.324/149, s.304 Part II
final_judgment: Application for condonation of delay and restoration allowed in Criminal Appeal No.700 of 2011; broader conviction challenge pending further consideration of unreliable evidence and procedural contradictions.
